scoreRule: 1 point per correct MC item; 10 points maximum; local provisional grade only
description: Independent email comprehension EN/A2 draft; human review required.

tabs.title: Making Plans
tabs.description: Follow the suggested day and the reasons behind it.

questions.q: Why was life in Galway difficult for Sofia at first?
choices: She had no language course to attend.
Her aunt refused to let her go outside.
She did not know people and found the weather colder than expected.
She could not find any shops in the town.
questions.explanation: The first paragraph explains Sofia's loneliness and surprise at the weather.

questions.q: What suggests that Sofia is happier now?
choices: She has made friends and they often cook together.
Her aunt works fewer hours every week.
The course has already ended.
She no longer misses her old school.
questions.explanation: New friendships and shared dinners show her new social life.

questions.q: Why does Sofia think the exhibition might interest Noah?
choices: He works at the old railway station.
She knows he enjoys taking photographs.
He has seen all the photos before.
He dislikes ordinary people's stories.
questions.explanation: Sofia remembers Noah's interest in photography when planning the visit.

questions.q: What is special about the photographer's subjects?
choices: Every photograph shows the same famous singer.
Only buildings and trains appear.
The exhibition is about wild animals.
The pictures show everyday people doing interesting work.
questions.explanation: The exhibition focuses on people such as bakers, drivers and musicians.

questions.q: What could Noah learn at the workshop after the exhibition?
choices: How to repair a bicycle.
How to play basketball professionally.
Ways to improve photographs taken with his phone.
How to bake bread for the museum.
questions.explanation: The free workshop teaches visitors how to take better phone photos.

questions.q: Why does Sofia suggest the science museum as another option?
choices: The photography exhibition might have no places left.
Noah has never seen any museum.
The railway station is closed on Sundays.
The workshop costs too much money.
questions.explanation: The museum is a backup if the exhibition is full.

questions.q: What matters more to Sofia than planning a perfect day?
choices: Visiting every attraction in town.
Buying expensive tickets.
Taking as many photos as possible.
Getting to spend some time with Noah.
questions.explanation: Sofia says even an hour together would make her happy.

questions.q: Why should Noah answer before Friday evening?
choices: The photography workshop closes on Thursday.
Sofia needs time to book a ticket.
The buses stop running after Friday.
The exhibition will be removed that night.
questions.explanation: Sofia gives a reply deadline because she must make a booking.

questions.q: Which reply would best help Sofia organise the outing?
choices: Sunday sounds great. I can come, and the museum is fine if the exhibition is full.
I might like photographs but I will not tell you anything.
Go to the exhibition alone and stop asking.
I am sure every ticket will be free.
questions.explanation: A useful response confirms availability and accepts the proposed alternative.

questions.q: What does Sofia show by asking about Noah's basketball team?
choices: She needs him to buy a new basketball.
She wants to stop talking about photography.
She also wants to know what has happened in his life.
She is planning to join his team in Galway.
questions.explanation: Sofia invites Noah to share his news, showing a two-way friendship.
